attchmntText: Nintec Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations'.
voiceSummary: NINtec Systems Limited disclosed the acquisition of 16829 equity shares by Rachana Niraj Gemawat and her Persons Acting in Concert, including Niraj Gemawat, Chhaganraj Gemawat, Sumanlata Gemawat, Indrajeet Mitra, Ketki Mitra, and VIN IT Solutions LLP. The shares were acquired via open market transactions on 9th and 11th November, 2026. This purchase represents 0.09 percent of the total voting capital. Prior to the acquisition, the group held 2573417 shares, constituting 13.85 percent of the voting rights. Following the transaction, their holding increased to 2590246 shares, representing 13.94 percent of the voting rights. The company’s total equity share capital remains 1,85,76,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each. This disclosure is submitted pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011.

attchmntText: Nintec Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure under Reg. 7(2) of SEBI (PIT) Regulations'.
voiceSummary: NINtec Systems Limited disclosed that Rachana Niraj Gemawat, a Promoter Group member and Director, purchased equity shares on 11th November 2026. The transactions were executed on market basis across BSE and NSE. The shareholding increased from 2573417 shares, representing 13.85 percent, to 2590246 shares, representing 13.94 percent. The disclosure was submitted pursuant to Regulation 7(2) of SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations 2015. No trading in derivatives was reported. The information was filed with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
